normalization_rules: Convert CamelCase boundaries to underscores before lowercasing.
Replace spaces, hyphens, and slashes with underscores.
Do not drop _link when producing a link target.
For a servo-axis target, omit _joint and use xr/yp/zy.
Never infer link merely from absence of an axis token; require an alias match, suffix, or topology.
When an alias maps to multiple candidates, return candidates and require context rather than guessing.

special_alias_policy.head_vs_neck: c_head_<axis> is permitted as a functional servo alias for a head-turn/tilt actuator; structural chain names remain c_neck[_NN]_<axis>.
special_alias_policy.waist_vs_spine: Legacy c_waist_* names are deprecated. Links map to c_pelvis; yaw/root actuators map to c_pelvis_root_<axis>; lumbar pitch maps to c_spine_01_<axis>.
special_alias_policy.singleton_chain: A single chain level may omit _01. When a second level is added, rename the original to _01 and use _02 for the new level.
special_alias_policy.pelvis: pelvis is primarily a link role (c_pelvis_link), not the default name for a legacy waist joint.
special_alias_policy.shoulder_link: l_/r_shoulder is a valid link between scapula and upper-arm chain; do not collapse shoulder links into scapula.
special_alias_policy.hipjoint_link: l_/r_hipjoint_upper and l_/r_hipjoint_lower are valid links for multi-axis hipjoints.
special_alias_policy.segment_links: l_/r_shoulder, elbow, wrist, knee, and ankle are first-class canonical link names. They are distinct from arm_upper/arm_lower and leg_upper/leg_lower segment links.
special_alias_policy.legacy_link_names: left_/right_ prefixed link names are deprecated. Use l_/r_ canonical names (e.g. l_arm_upper_yaw, l_fore_shoulder). _tbd_* placeholder links are renamed to provisional l_/r_* names.
special_alias_policy.quadruped_attachment: Quadruped forelimb root links (l_/r_fore_upper_limb) attach to c_torso. Hindlimb root links (l_/r_hind_pelvic_limb) attach to c_pelvis.
special_alias_policy.wing_attachment: Avian wing root link l_/r_wing_upper attaches to l_/r_scapula (shoulder blade).
special_alias_policy.tail_attachment: Tail root link c_tail_01 attaches to c_pelvis.
special_alias_policy.c_base: c_base is deprecated; use c_base_link only.
special_alias_policy.pelvis_spine_joints: Joints spanning c_waist/c_pelvis to c_chest/c_torso map to the first pelvis→spine hop (c_spine_01_yp) unless axis/topology selects another spine segment.
special_alias_policy.ancestor_parent_resolution: When URDF parent name differs from link_tree direct parent, treat URDF parent as valid if it appears in the ancestor chain (walk up link_tree parents).

servo_targets.singleton_chain_rule: A single neck rotational level may omit _01: c_neck_zy. When a second level is introduced, rename the original to c_neck_01_zy and name the new level c_neck_02_zy. For a head-turn actuator, c_head_zy is a permitted functional alias.
